short_description.id: Apsara adalah kelompok makhluk perempuan surgawi dalam tradisi Hindu dan Buddha.
short_description.en: Apsaras are a class of celestial female beings in Hindu and Buddhist traditions.

long_description.id: Apsara adalah kelompok makhluk perempuan surgawi dalam tradisi Hindu dan Buddha. Mereka dikenal sebagai penari istana Indra.
long_description.en: Apsaras are a class of celestial female beings in Hindu and Buddhist traditions. They are known as dancers at Indra's court.

long_description.id: Gandharva berhubungan dengan mereka sebagai musisi dan pasangan. Sebagian kisah memberi mereka kemampuan mengubah wujud. Indra mengirim apsara menggoda resi yang bertapa dalam sejumlah cerita. Urvashi, Menaka, Rambha, Tilottama, dan Ghritachi termasuk apsara yang dikenal. Di Jepang, nama Tennin dan Tennyo digunakan untuk sosok terkait apsara. Etimologi Monier-Williams menghubungkan namanya dengan bergerak di air atau di antara air awan. Uraian awal membandingkan apsara dengan nimfa air. Rigveda memuat dialog Urvashi dengan kekasih manusia Pururavas. Kaushitaki Upanishad mengaitkan apsara dengan minyak wangi, rangkaian bunga, pakaian, dan wewangian bubuk. Ramayana dan Purana menghubungkan asal apsara dengan pengadukan lautan. Mahabharata menuturkan Tilottama menyelamatkan dunia dari Sunda dan Upasunda. Mackenzie menuturkan apsara menari ketika Gandharva memainkan alat musik ilahi.
long_description.en: Gandharvas are associated with them as musicians and partners. Some accounts give them the ability to change shape. Indra sends apsaras to tempt ascetic sages in several stories. Urvashi, Menaka, Rambha, Tilottama, and Ghritachi are among the known apsaras. In Japan, the names Tennin and Tennyo are used for figures associated with apsaras. Monier Williams's etymology connects the name with moving in water or among cloud waters. Early descriptions compare apsaras to water nymphs. The Rigveda contains Urvashi's dialogue with her mortal lover Pururavas. The Kaushitaki Upanishad associates apsaras with ointments, garlands, clothes, and powdered aromatics. The Ramayana and Puranas connect the origin of apsaras with the churning of the ocean. The Mahabharata recounts Tilottama saving the world from Sunda and Upasunda. Mackenzie recounts apsaras dancing when Gandharvas play divine instruments.

short_description.id: Enki atau Ea adalah dewa kebijaksanaan, air tawar, dan kecerdasan Sumeria.
short_description.en: Sumerian tradition associates Enki, also named Ea, with wisdom, intelligence, and freshwater.

long_description.id: Enki atau Ea adalah dewa kebijaksanaan, air tawar, dan kecerdasan Sumeria. Penggambaran Enki menunjukkan pria berjanggut dengan tutup kepala bertanduk dan jubah panjang.
long_description.en: Sumerian tradition associates Enki, also named Ea, with wisdom, intelligence, and freshwater. Images show Enki with a beard, long robes, and a cap bearing horns.

long_description.id: Aliran air digambarkan keluar dari bahu Enki. Nama Enki diartikan sebagai Penguasa Bumi. Ikan dan kambing menjadi simbol Enki yang dijelaskan sebagai lambang kesuburan. Enki menjadi pelindung Eridu, kota yang dianggap pertama didirikan. Catatan tertulisnya ditelusuri ke Periode Dinasti Awal III. Dalam mitologi Sumeria dan Akkadia, Anu disebut sebagai ayah Enki. Teks Babilonia menyebut Enki sebagai putra Apsu. Versi lain menyebut Nammu sebagai ibunya. Enki membentuk triad Mesopotamia bersama Anu dan Enlil. Dalam Enuma Elish, Enki menidurkan ayahnya sebelum membunuhnya. Dalam Turunnya Inanna, dewi itu mempercayai Enki dapat menghidupkannya kembali. Damgalnuna disebut sebagai istri Enki. Kambing-ikan, tongkat berkepala domba, dan kura-kura adalah simbol Enki.
long_description.en: Streams of water are depicted flowing from Enki’s shoulders. Enki’s name is interpreted as Lord of the Earth. Fish and goats are Enki’s symbols, explained as representing fertility. Enki protects Eridu, regarded as the first established city. Written references to Enki are traced to Early Dynastic Period III. Sumerian and Akkadian mythology identifies Anu as Enki’s father. Babylonian texts identify Enki as Apsu’s son. Enki is also referred to as the goddess Nammu’s son. Enki forms an early Mesopotamian triad with Anu and Enlil. In the Enuma Elish, Enki puts his father into a deep sleep before killing him. In the Descent of Inanna, the goddess trusts Enki to restore her to life. Damgalnuna is identified as Enki’s wife. Enki’s primary symbols include the goat-fish, a ram-headed staff, and the turtle.

short_description.id: Kematian adalah personifikasi kematian dalam berbagai mitologi dunia, kerap digambarkan sebagai kerangka berjubah pembawa sabit atau pemandu jiwa.
short_description.en: Death is the personification of dying in global mythologies, often portrayed as a cloaked skeleton wielding a scythe or as a guiding psychopomp.

long_description.id: Personifikasi kematian hadir dalam banyak mitologi dan agama di dunia, serta digambarkan sebagai salah satu dari Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Dalam kisah modern, sosok ini sering dikenal sebagai Grim Reaper berwujud kerangka berjubah yang membawa sabit untuk menjemput jiwa. Pandangan lain menganggap sosok kematian adalah psychopomp atau pemandu yang bertugas mengantar orang yang meninggal ke alam baka tanpa mengendalikan saat terjadinya ajal.
long_description.en: Personifications of death are found in many religions and mythologies, portrayed among the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. In modern stories, this figure is known as the Grim Reaper, depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe to collect souls. Other beliefs describe death as a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when a person dies.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi Greek, Thanatos dipandang sebagai perwujudan roh kematian tanpa kekerasan, bertangan lembut mendampingi saudaranya Hypnos, sedangkan kematian akibat kekerasan berada di ranah saudari-saudarinya, Keres. Seni lukis vas Greek dan relief Roman menggambarkan sosoknya bersayap atau membawa obor dan kupu-kupu penanda jiwa. Di berbagai belahan dunia sosok kematian juga berwujud perempuan seperti Santa Muerte di Mexico, sebutan la Parca di Latin America, serta kostucha di Poland dengan jubah putih.
long_description.en: In Greek traditions, Thanatos was regarded as the personified spirit of non-violent death with a gentle touch alongside his brother Hypnos, while violent death belonged to his sisters, the Keres. Greek vase painting and Roman reliefs depicted him with wings or holding a torch and butterfly. Worldwide, death also takes female forms such as Santa Muerte in Mexico, la Parca across Latin America, and kostucha in Poland with a white robe.

note.en: Hypnos is the twin brother of Thanatos.

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana pandangan terhadap kematian berkembang dari pemandu jiwa yang lembut menjadi sosok kerangka bersabit yang ditakuti?
learning_questions.en: How did views of death evolve from a gentle guide of souls into a feared skeletal figure bearing a scythe?

short_description.id: Perun adalah dewa tertinggi dalam mitologi Slavia, penguasa langit, guruh, dan petir, yang juga dikaitkan dengan perang, hukum, dan pohon ek.
short_description.en: Perun is the highest god of Slavic mythology, lord of the sky, thunder and lightning, also linked with war, law and oak trees.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, Perun menempati puncak jajaran dewa. Ia memerintah langit, guruh, petir, badai, dan hujan, serta berkaitan dengan hukum, perang, kesuburan, dan pohon ek. Lambang lain yang melekat padanya antara lain api, gunung, angin, bunga iris, elang, kuda dan kereta, serta senjata berupa palu, kapak, dan anak panah. Para peneliti juga menggambarkannya sebagai dewa badai tertinggi yang dihubungkan dengan batu, guruh, kilat, hujan, perang, dan keadilan.
long_description.en: In Slavic mythology Perun stands at the top of the pantheon. He rules the sky, thunder, lightning, storms and rain, and is tied to law, war, fertility and oak trees. Other emblems attached to him include fire, mountains, wind, the iris, the eagle, horses and carts, and weapons such as the hammer, the axe and the arrow. Scholars also describe him as a supreme storm god connected with rock, thunder, lightning, rain, war and justice.

long_description.id: Di Rus Kiev pada abad ke-9 sampai ke-10 ia adalah dewa tertinggi, mula-mula dikaitkan dengan senjata batu lalu dengan senjata logam. Ia sudah disebut pada abad ke-6 oleh sejarawan Romawi Timur Procopius dalam De Bello Gothico. Pada tahun 980 Vladimir mendirikan arca lima dewa pagan di depan istananya, dan Perun menjadi yang utama, dengan kepala perak dan kumis emas. Hari rayanya dirayakan dengan persembahan pada bulan Juli.
long_description.en: In Kievan Rus during the 9th and 10th centuries he was the supreme god, associated first with stone weapons and later with metal ones. He was already mentioned in the 6th century by the Eastern Roman historian Procopius in De Bello Gothico. In 980 Vladimir set up statues of five pagan gods before his palace, with Perun foremost among them, bearing a silver head and a golden moustache. His feast was celebrated with sacrifices in July.

long_description.id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, kilat Perun berupa batu dan anak panah batu, sehingga fulgurit, belemnit, dan perkakas batu prasejarah yang ditemukan di tanah dianggap sisa senjatanya. Senjata itu dipercaya melindungi dari nasib buruk, sihir jahat, penyakit, dan petir. Satu sumber menggambarkannya sebagai lelaki paruh baya berjanggut yang terbang di atas batu gilingan sambil melepaskan kilat dan guruh.
long_description.en: In folk belief Perun's lightning bolts were stones and stone arrows, so fulgurites, belemnites and prehistoric stone tools found in the ground were taken as remains of his weapons. These weapons were thought to guard against bad luck, evil magic, disease and lightning. One source pictures him as a bearded middle-aged man flying on a millstone while hurling lightning and thunder.

long_description.id: Perun dikatakan menikahi Matahari, tetapi berbagi istri dengan musuhnya Veles, karena Matahari setiap malam turun ke dunia bawah yang dikuasai Veles. Tempat pemujaannya berada di puncak gunung atau bukit, atau di hutan keramat di bawah pohon ek tua, dengan persembahan banteng, sapi, domba jantan, dan telur. Ia juga dihubungkan dengan hari Kamis dan dengan logam timah.
long_description.en: Perun was said to be married to the Sun, but he shared his wife with his enemy Veles, since the Sun sank each night into the underworld ruled by Veles. His shrines stood on mountain tops or hills, or in sacred groves under ancient oaks, with offerings of a bull, an ox, a ram and eggs. He was also linked with Thursday and with tin.

long_description.id: Setelah masuk Kristen, Vladimir memerintahkan arca-arca Perun dirobohkan, diseret, dipukuli, lalu dibuang ke sungai; menurut satu sumber arcanya dilempar ke Sungai Dnipro dan di tempatnya dibangun Gereja Santo Basil. Gereja menggantikan pemujaan Perun dengan pemujaan Santo Elia, yang mewarisi semua sifat Perun, tetapi orang Lemko masih menganggap ungkapan "Semoga Perun menyambarmu mati" sebagai kutukan paling mengerikan. Kini Perun termasuk dewa yang paling dihormati dalam neopaganisme Slavia (rodnovery), sebagai dewa pejuang dan saingan Veles.
long_description.en: After his conversion Vladimir had the statues of Perun torn down, dragged, beaten and thrown into rivers; one source says the statue was cast into the Dnipro River and Saint Basil's Church was built on its site. The Church replaced the cult of Perun with that of Saint Elijah, who inherited all his qualities, yet the Lemkos still regard "May Perun strike you dead" as the most terrible curse. Today Perun is among the most revered gods of Slavic neopaganism (rodnovery), as a god of warriors and a rival of Veles.

claims.quote: In Slavic mythology, Perun (Cyrillic: Перун ) is the highest god of the pantheon and the god of sky, thunder, lightning, storms, rain, law, war, fertility and oak trees.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, Perun (Перун) adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa, dewa langit, guruh, petir, badai, hujan, hukum, perang, kesuburan, dan pohon ek.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology, Perun (Перун) is the highest god of the pantheon and god of sky, thunder, lightning, storms, rain, law, war, fertility and oak trees.

claims.quote: His other attributes were fire, mountains, wind, iris, eagle, firmament ... horses and carts, and weapons (hammer, axe (Axe of Perun), and arrow).

statement.id: Atribut lain Perun adalah api, gunung, angin, bunga iris, elang, cakrawala, kuda dan kereta, serta senjata berupa palu, kapak (Kapak Perun), dan anak panah.
statement.en: His other attributes were fire, mountains, wind, iris, eagle, firmament, horses and carts, and weapons: hammer, axe (Axe of Perun) and arrow.

claims.quote: The supreme god in the Kievan Rus' during the 9th-10th centuries, Perun was first associated with weapons made of stone and later with those of metal.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa tertinggi di Rus Kiev pada abad ke-9 sampai ke-10, Perun mula-mula dikaitkan dengan senjata dari batu, kemudian dengan senjata logam.
statement.en: The supreme god in Kievan Rus in the 9th-10th centuries, Perun was first associated with stone weapons and later with metal ones.

claims.quote: To this day, the word perun in a number of Slavic languages means "thunder," or "lightning bolt".

statement.id: Hingga kini, dalam sejumlah bahasa Slavia kata perun berarti "guruh" atau "sambaran petir".
statement.en: To this day, in a number of Slavic languages the word perun means "thunder" or "lightning bolt".

claims.quote: As early as the 6th century, he was mentioned in De Bello Gothico, a historical source written by the Eastern Roman historian Procopius.

statement.id: Sejak abad ke-6 ia sudah disebut dalam De Bello Gothico, sumber sejarah karya sejarawan Romawi Timur Procopius.
statement.en: As early as the 6th century he was mentioned in De Bello Gothico, a historical source by the Eastern Roman historian Procopius.

claims.quote: In 980, when prince Vladimir the Great came to the throne of Kiev, he erected statues of five pagan gods in front of his palace which he soon thereafter discarded after his Christianization in 988. Perun was chief among these, represented with a silver head and a golden moustache.

statement.id: Pada tahun 980, ketika pangeran Vladimir Agung naik takhta di Kiev, ia mendirikan arca lima dewa pagan di depan istananya, yang kemudian ia singkirkan setelah masuk Kristen pada 988; Perun adalah yang utama, digambarkan berkepala perak dan berkumis emas.
statement.en: In 980, when Prince Vladimir the Great took the throne of Kiev, he erected statues of five pagan gods before his palace, discarding them after his Christianization in 988; Perun was chief among them, with a silver head and a golden moustache.

claims.quote: Perun is strongly correlated with the near-identical Perkūnas/Pērkons from Baltic mythology, suggesting either a common derivative of the Proto-Indo European thunder god

statement.id: Perun sangat berkaitan dengan Perkūnas/Pērkons yang hampir identik dari mitologi Baltik, yang menunjukkan asal bersama dari dewa guruh Proto-Indo-Eropa atau peminjaman.
statement.en: Perun is strongly correlated with the near-identical Perkūnas/Pērkons of Baltic mythology, suggesting a common Proto-Indo-European thunder god origin or borrowing.

claims.quote: The root *perkwu originally probably meant oak, but in Proto-Slavic this evolved into *per- meaning "to strike, to slay".

statement.id: Akar *perkwu semula mungkin berarti pohon ek, tetapi dalam bahasa Proto-Slavia berkembang menjadi *per- yang berarti "memukul, membunuh".
statement.en: The root *perkwu probably first meant oak, but in Proto-Slavic it became *per-, meaning "to strike, to slay".

claims.quote: Perun's lightning bolts were believed to be stones and stone arrows. According to folk beliefs, fulgurites, belemnites, and sometimes even the remains of prehistoric stone tools found in the ground are remains of these weapons.

statement.id: Kilat Perun dipercaya berupa batu dan anak panah batu; menurut kepercayaan rakyat, fulgurit, belemnit, dan kadang perkakas batu prasejarah yang ditemukan di tanah adalah sisa senjata itu.
statement.en: Perun's lightning bolts were believed to be stones and stone arrows; folk belief held fulgurites, belemnites and sometimes prehistoric stone tools found in the ground to be remains of these weapons.

claims.quote: The weapons of Perun protected against bad luck, evil magic, disease, and – naturally enough – lightning itself.

statement.id: Senjata Perun melindungi dari nasib buruk, sihir jahat, penyakit, dan juga dari petir itu sendiri.
statement.en: The weapons of Perun protected against bad luck, evil magic, disease and lightning itself.

claims.quote: it can also be shown that Perun was married to the Sun. He, however, shared his wife with his enemy Veles, as each night the Sun was thought of as diving behind the horizon and into the underworld, the realm of the dead over which Veles ruled.

statement.id: Perun dapat ditunjukkan menikahi Matahari, tetapi ia berbagi istri dengan musuhnya Veles, karena setiap malam Matahari dianggap terbenam ke dunia bawah, alam orang mati yang dikuasai Veles.
statement.en: Perun can be shown to have been married to the Sun, but he shared his wife with his enemy Veles, as each night the Sun was thought to dive into the underworld, the realm of the dead ruled by Veles.

claims.quote: Shrines of Perun were located either on top of mountains or hills, or in sacred groves underneath ancient oaks. These were general places of worship and sacrifices (with a bull, an ox, a ram, and eggs).

statement.id: Tempat pemujaan Perun berada di puncak gunung atau bukit, atau di hutan keramat di bawah pohon ek tua; di sana dilakukan ibadah dan persembahan berupa banteng, sapi, domba jantan, dan telur.
statement.en: Perun's shrines stood on mountain tops or hills, or in sacred groves under ancient oaks, as places of worship and sacrifice (a bull, an ox, a ram and eggs).

claims.quote: In addition to the tree association, Perun had a day association (Thursday) as well as the material association (tin).

statement.id: Selain pohon, Perun juga dikaitkan dengan satu hari, yaitu Kamis (Thursday), dan dengan satu bahan, yaitu timah.
statement.en: Besides the tree, Perun was associated with a day (Thursday) and a material (tin).

claims.quote: He ordered that the statues of Perun which he himself had erected formerly, be dethroned, torn down with great dishonor and dragged through the streets as they were beaten with sticks. The idols were then cast into rivers and not permitted to land on the shore.

statement.id: Ia memerintahkan agar arca-arca Perun yang dulu didirikannya sendiri dirobohkan dengan hina dan diseret di jalan sambil dipukuli tongkat, lalu dibuang ke sungai dan tidak dibiarkan terdampar di tepi.
statement.en: He ordered the statues of Perun he had once erected to be torn down in disgrace and dragged through the streets while beaten with sticks, then cast into rivers and not allowed to land on the shore.

claims.quote: Perun is one of the most revered gods in Slavic neopaganism (rodnovery). He is considered a thunderer, the god of warriors, and a rival of Veles, also embodying spring thunderstorms that fertilize the earth.

statement.id: Perun adalah salah satu dewa yang paling dihormati dalam neopaganisme Slavia (rodnovery); ia dianggap dewa guruh, dewa para pejuang, dan saingan Veles, serta perwujudan badai musim semi yang menyuburkan bumi.
statement.en: Perun is one of the most revered gods of Slavic neopaganism (rodnovery), seen as a thunderer, god of warriors and rival of Veles, embodying spring storms that fertilize the earth.

claims.quote: The Baltic tribes had a widespread cult of the thunderer Perkunas, one of the main deities of the Baltic pantheon. With Perun, this deity also shares common attributes (amulets in the form of an axe, a fiery four-pointed symbol, oak as the main tree)
claims.locator: The cult of Perun among neighboring tribes

statement.id: Suku-suku Baltik memuja dewa guruh Perkunas, salah satu dewa utama mereka, yang memiliki atribut sama dengan Perun: jimat berbentuk kapak, simbol api berujung empat, dan pohon ek sebagai pohon utama.
statement.en: The Baltic tribes widely worshipped the thunderer Perkunas, a main Baltic deity sharing attributes with Perun: axe amulets, a fiery four-pointed symbol and the oak as chief tree.

claims.quote: Among South Slavs, a mountain plant Iris germanica is known in folklore as perunika ("Perun's plant") and sometimes also as bogisha ("god's plant"), and was believed to grow from ground that had been struck by lightning.

statement.id: Di kalangan Slavia Selatan, tanaman gunung Iris germanica dikenal dalam cerita rakyat sebagai perunika ("tanaman Perun") dan kadang bogisha ("tanaman dewa"), dan dipercaya tumbuh dari tanah yang tersambar petir.
statement.en: Among South Slavs the mountain plant Iris germanica is known in folklore as perunika ("Perun's plant") and sometimes bogisha ("god's plant"), believed to grow from ground struck by lightning.

claims.quote: The Bulgarian and Macedonian people believe that the name of the Bulgarian mountain Pirin, one of the highest mountains of the Balkan Peninsula, was named after Perun.

statement.id: Orang Bulgaria dan Makedonia percaya bahwa Pirin, salah satu gunung tertinggi di Semenanjung Balkan, dinamai menurut Perun.
statement.en: Bulgarians and Macedonians believe the Bulgarian mountain Pirin, one of the highest in the Balkan Peninsula, was named after Perun.

claims.quote: Perun. One of the principal deities in eastern and northern Slavic mythology. In pre-Christian Kyivan Rus’ this was the chief god—the god of thunder, lightning, and rain, the ruler of the heavens, and, later, the god of war.

statement.id: Perun adalah salah satu dewa utama dalam mitologi Slavia timur dan utara; di Rus Kyiv sebelum Kristen ia dewa tertinggi, dewa guruh, kilat, dan hujan, penguasa langit, dan kemudian dewa perang.
statement.en: Perun is one of the principal deities of eastern and northern Slavic mythology; in pre-Christian Kyivan Rus he was the chief god, god of thunder, lightning and rain, ruler of the heavens and later god of war.

claims.quote: In 980 a wooden statue of Perun with a silver head and golden moustache stood on Perun Hill in Kyiv. Perun's feast, celebrated with sacrifices, took place in July.

statement.id: Pada tahun 980 arca kayu Perun berkepala perak dan berkumis emas berdiri di Bukit Perun di Kyiv; hari raya Perun dirayakan dengan persembahan pada bulan Juli.
statement.en: In 980 a wooden statue of Perun with a silver head and golden moustache stood on Perun Hill in Kyiv; his feast, with sacrifices, took place in July.

claims.quote: After adopting Christianity Prince Volodymyr the Great ordered Perun's statue to be cast into the Dnipro River and on its site built Saint Basil's Church.

statement.id: Setelah memeluk Kristen, Pangeran Volodymyr (Vladimir) Agung memerintahkan arca Perun dilempar ke Sungai Dnipro dan membangun Gereja Santo Basil di tempatnya.
statement.en: After adopting Christianity, Prince Volodymyr the Great had Perun's statue cast into the Dnipro River and built Saint Basil's Church on its site.

claims.quote: The Christian church replaced the cult of Perun with the cult of Saint Elijah (feast day: 2 August, or 20 July OS), to whom all of Perun's qualities were transferred.

statement.id: Gereja Kristen menggantikan pemujaan Perun dengan pemujaan Santo Elia, yang menerima semua sifat Perun.
statement.en: The Christian church replaced the cult of Perun with that of Saint Elijah, to whom all of Perun's qualities were transferred.

claims.quote: The Lemkos still consider the expression ‘May Perun strike you dead’ as the most terrible curse.

statement.id: Orang Lemko masih menganggap ungkapan "Semoga Perun menyambarmu mati" sebagai kutukan paling mengerikan.
statement.en: The Lemkos still regard the expression "May Perun strike you dead" as the most terrible curse.

claims.quote: The author analyses Perun, a supreme Storm-God in Old-Slavic pagan religion and mythology, which is correlated to rock, thunder, lightning and rain, war and justice.

statement.id: Penulis menganalisis Perun sebagai dewa badai tertinggi dalam agama dan mitologi pagan Slavia Kuno, yang berkaitan dengan batu, guruh, kilat, hujan, perang, dan keadilan.
statement.en: The author analyses Perun as a supreme storm god of Old Slavic pagan religion and mythology, correlated with rock, thunder, lightning, rain, war and justice.

claims.quote: For more than a century, scholars of Slavic mythology have adopted the assumption connecting the German iris (Iris germanica) plant and the cult of the god Perun.

statement.id: Selama lebih dari seabad, para ahli mitologi Slavia menerima anggapan yang menghubungkan tanaman iris Jerman (Iris germanica) dengan pemujaan dewa Perun.
statement.en: For more than a century, scholars of Slavic mythology have assumed a connection between the German iris (Iris germanica) and the cult of Perun.

claims.quote: the author concludes that there are no grounds for linking the plant to the cult of Perun, the god of thunder. The motivation for the name “perunika” comes from its dominant feather-like (perasti) leaves

statement.id: Penulis menyimpulkan tidak ada dasar untuk mengaitkan tanaman itu dengan pemujaan Perun, dewa guruh; nama "perunika" berasal dari daunnya yang mirip bulu (perasti).
statement.en: The author concludes there are no grounds for linking the plant to the cult of Perun, the thunder god; the name "perunika" comes from its feather-like (perasti) leaves.

claims.quote: Perun was worshipped by the Varangian (Scandinavian) warriors hired by Oleg and Igor during the campaigns against Byzantium ... It is likely that the purely Slavic god Perun replaced for them the Scandinavian Thor, also the thunderer.
claims.locator: The cult of Perun among neighboring tribes

statement.id: Perun dipuja para prajurit Varangia (Skandinavia) yang disewa Oleg dan Igor dalam kampanye melawan Bizantium; kemungkinan besar bagi mereka Perun menggantikan Thor dari Skandinavia, yang juga dewa guruh.
statement.en: Perun was worshipped by the Varangian (Scandinavian) warriors hired by Oleg and Igor against Byzantium; for them the purely Slavic Perun likely replaced the Scandinavian Thor, also a thunderer.

claims.quote: ペルーン（ウクライナ語 / キリル表記：Перун、ラテン表記：Perun）またはペルンは、スラヴ神話の主神であり、雷神。ロシア語ではほかにピィエルン (Pyerun)、またポーランド語ではピョルンまたはピオルン (Piorun)

statement.id: Perun (Перун) adalah dewa utama mitologi Slavia dan dewa guruh; dalam bahasa Rusia ia juga disebut Pyerun, dan dalam bahasa Polandia Piorun.
statement.en: Perun (Перун) is the chief god of Slavic mythology and a thunder god; in Russian he is also called Pyerun, and in Polish Piorun.

claims.quote: 類似する多くの雷神と同じように、髭を生やした中年男性の姿をしている。 石臼に乗って空を飛びながら稲妻を放ち雷鳴を轟かせる。

statement.id: Seperti banyak dewa guruh lain, ia berwujud lelaki paruh baya berjanggut; ia terbang di atas batu gilingan sambil melepaskan kilat dan guruh.
statement.en: Like many thunder gods he has the form of a bearded middle-aged man; he flies on a millstone, hurling lightning and thunder.

claims.quote: The Finnic peoples had a deity Ukko, which had similar functions and attributes with the Slavic and Baltic deities.
claims.locator: The cult of Perun among neighboring tribes

statement.id: Bangsa-bangsa Finnik memiliki dewa Ukko dengan fungsi dan atribut yang mirip dengan dewa Slavia dan Baltik.
statement.en: The Finnic peoples had a god Ukko with functions and attributes similar to the Slavic and Baltic deities.

topic.en: Link between the perunika iris and Perun

summary.id: Satu sumber: bunga iris disebut perunika ("tanaman Perun") dan dipercaya tumbuh di tanah bekas sambaran petir; para ahli lama mengaitkannya dengan pemujaan Perun.
summary.en: One source: the iris is called perunika ("Perun's plant") and was believed to grow where lightning struck; scholars long linked it with Perun's cult.

summary.id: Sumber lain: tidak ada dasar mengaitkan tanaman itu dengan Perun; namanya berasal dari daunnya yang mirip bulu.
summary.en: Another source: there are no grounds for linking the plant to Perun; the name comes from its feather-like leaves.

short_description.id: Taweret adalah dewi Mesir pelindung kelahiran dan kesuburan.
short_description.en: Taweret is an Egyptian goddess protecting childbirth and fertility.

long_description.id: Taweret adalah dewi Mesir pelindung kelahiran dan kesuburan. Namanya berarti Yang Agung.
long_description.en: Taweret is an Egyptian goddess protecting childbirth and fertility. Her name means the Great One.

long_description.id: Ia berupa kuda nil betina berkaki dua dengan unsur singa dan buaya. Ia dekat dengan dewi kuda nil Ipet, Reret, dan Hedjet. Gambarnya menghiasi pisau atau tongkat magis untuk ritual perlindungan bayi. Taweret juga disebut pasangan Bes dalam sumber pendamping.
long_description.en: She takes the form of a bipedal female hippopotamus with lion and crocodile features. She is closely associated with the hippopotamus goddesses Ipet, Reret and Hedjet. Her image adorns magical knives or wands used in infant-protection rites. Taweret is also called Bes’s consort in the accompanying source.

statement.en: Her name means the Great One.

claims.quote: The deity is typically depicted as a bipedal female hippopotamus with feline attributes, pendulous female human breasts, the limbs and paws of a lion, and the back and tail of a Nile crocodile.

statement.id: Ia berupa kuda nil betina berkaki dua dengan unsur singa dan buaya.

claims.quote: From her ideological conception, Taweret was closely grouped with (and is often indistinguishable from) several other protective hippopotamus goddesses: Ipet, Reret, and Hedjet. Some scholars even interpret these goddesses as aspects of the same deity, considering their universally shared role as protective household goddesses.

statement.id: Ia dekat dengan dewi kuda nil Ipet, Reret, dan Hedjet.
statement.en: She is closely associated with the hippopotamus goddesses Ipet, Reret and Hedjet.

claims.quote: It was not until the Middle Kingdom of Egypt (c. 2055–1650 BCE) that Taweret became featured more prominently as a figure of religious devotion. Her image adorns magical objects, the most notable of which being a common type of "wand" or "knife" carved from hippopotamus ivory that was likely used in rituals associated with birth and the protection of infants.

statement.id: Gambarnya menghiasi pisau atau tongkat magis untuk ritual perlindungan bayi.
statement.en: Her image adorns magical knives or wands used in infant-protection rites.

claims.quote: She is further identified as the consort of Bes, the dwarf god of childbirth, sexuality, humor, and war.

statement.id: Taweret juga disebut pasangan Bes dalam sumber pendamping.
statement.en: Taweret is also called Bes’s consort in the accompanying source.

short_description.id: Yaksha merupakan kelompok roh alam dalam mitologi Hindu yang berkaitan dengan air, pepohonan, hutan, harta, dan kesuburan.
short_description.en: Yakshas are a class of nature spirits in Hindu mythology associated with water, trees, forests, treasure, and fertility.

long_description.id: Yaksha merupakan kelompok roh alam dalam mitologi Hindu yang berkaitan dengan air, pepohonan, hutan, harta, dan kesuburan. Bentuk perempuan disebut yakshi atau yakshini.
long_description.en: Yakshas are a class of nature spirits in Hindu mythology associated with water, trees, forests, treasure, and fertility. The female form is called yakshi or yakshini.

long_description.id: Versi yaksha dapat berupa roh alam yang tidak berbahaya atau hantu yang menghadang dan memangsa pelancong. Kubera dipandang sebagai raja para yaksha dalam Hindu, Buddha, dan Jain. Dalam literatur Buddhis, yaksha menjadi pengiring Vaisravana, penjaga arah utara. Mackenzie menyebut yaksha sebagai penjaga harta tersembunyi yang berkaitan dengan Kuvera.
long_description.en: A yaksha may be a harmless nature spirit or a ghost that waylays and devours travellers. Kubera is regarded as king of yakshas in Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism. In Buddhist literature yakshas attend Vaisravana, guardian of the northern quarter. Mackenzie calls yakshas guardians of hidden treasure associated with Kuvera.

note.en: King of yakshas.

short_description.id: Leprechaun adalah makhluk gaib bertubuh kecil dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, oleh sebagian digolongkan sebagai peri penyendiri, yang digambarkan sebagai lelaki kecil berjanggut yang suka berbuat usil.
short_description.en: The leprechaun is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, classed by some as a solitary fairy, pictured as a little bearded man fond of mischief.

long_description.id: Leprechaun (bahasa Irlandia: leipreachán) adalah makhluk gaib bertubuh kecil dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish folklore), yang oleh sebagian orang digolongkan sebagai sejenis peri penyendiri. Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai lelaki kecil berjanggut bermantel dan bertopi yang suka berbuat usil; belakangan ia digambarkan sebagai pembuat sepatu yang menyimpan sepanci emas di ujung pelangi. Kata leprechaun berasal dari bahasa Irlandia Kuno luchorpán atau lupracán.
long_description.en: The leprechaun (Irish: leipreachán) is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, classed by some as a type of solitary fairy. It is usually pictured as a small bearded man in a coat and hat who gets up to mischief; in later times it became a shoemaker with a hidden pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. The word comes from Old Irish luchorpán or lupracán.

long_description.id: Rujukan tertua tentang leprechaun terdapat dalam kisah abad pertengahan Echtra Fergus mac Léti: Fergus mac Léti, raja Ulster, tertidur di pantai dan terbangun ketika diseret ke laut oleh tiga lúchorpáin; ia menangkap mereka, dan mereka memberinya tiga permintaan agar dilepaskan. Dalam cerita rakyat, leprechaun adalah makhluk penyendiri yang pekerjaan utamanya membuat dan menambal sepatu dan yang gemar bercanda; manusia yang menangkapnya dapat menolak melepaskannya sampai diberi kekayaan gaib.
long_description.en: The earliest known reference to the leprechaun is in the medieval tale Echtra Fergus mac Léti: the Ulster king Fergus mac Léti dozes off on the shore and awakes to find three lúchorpáin hauling him into the waves; he captures them, and they grant him three wishes for their release. In folklore the leprechaun is a solitary creature whose main work is making and cobbling shoes and who loves practical jokes; a human who catches one may refuse to free it until given supernatural wealth.

long_description.id: William Butler Yeats menggolongkan leprechaun sebagai "peri penyendiri" dan menyebut kekayaannya berasal dari guci harta yang dikubur pada masa perang. Sebelum abad ke-20 leprechaun umumnya dibayangkan berbaju merah, bukan hijau; gambaran modern dengan topi hijau dan janggut merah adalah ciptaan yang lebih baru. Menurut artikel id, leprechaun adalah sebangsa peri jantan yang mendiami Irlandia sebelum kedatangan bangsa Kelt, dan siapa pun yang mencuri gentong emasnya dapat meminta tiga permintaan sebagai ganti gentong itu; ia juga dikaitkan dengan perayaan Hari Santo Patrick.
long_description.en: William Butler Yeats classed the leprechaun as a "solitary fairy" and said its wealth came from treasure-crocks buried in wartime. Before the 20th century the leprechaun was generally held to wear red, not green; the modern image with green hat and red beard is a later invention. According to the id article, the leprechaun is a male fairy folk dwelling in Ireland before the coming of the Celts, and whoever steals its pot of gold may claim three wishes in exchange for its return; it is also linked with Saint Patrick's Day.

short_description.id: Goblin adalah makhluk humanoid kecil, aneh, dan sering jahat yang menonjol dalam cerita rakyat Eropa, terkenal karena sifatnya yang usil atau iblis dan kemampuannya berubah wujud.
short_description.en: A goblin is a small, grotesque and often malevolent humanoid creature prominent in European folklore, known for its mischievous or demonic nature and ability to shapeshift.

long_description.id: Goblin adalah makhluk humanoid yang kecil, aneh rupanya, dan sering jahat, yang menonjol dalam cerita rakyat Eropa (European folklore). Ia dikenal usil atau bersifat iblis, bertubuh kecil (dalam sebagian tradisi sekitar 30 cm), berbulu atau berkulit seperti kulit samak, dan dapat berubah wujud. Goblin dipercaya tinggal di bawah tanah atau di rumah-rumah, tempat mereka melakukan apa saja dari lelucon hingga pembunuhan. Kata ini juga sering dipakai sebagai sebutan umum untuk semua makhluk peri kecil.
long_description.en: A goblin is a small, grotesque and often malevolent humanoid creature prominent in European folklore. It is known for a mischievous or demonic nature, small stature (about 30 cm in some traditions), a furry or leathery look and the power to change shape. Goblins are believed to live underground or in households, where they do anything from pranks to murder. The word is also often used as a blanket term for all small fay creatures.

long_description.id: Kata goblin masuk ke bahasa Inggris pada awal abad ke-14 dari bahasa Prancis Kuno gobelin, yang pertama tercatat pada 1195 dalam kronik L'Estoire de la guerre sainte karya rahib Ambroise; bentuk Latin Abad Pertengahannya, gobelinus, muncul sekitar 1140 dalam Historia ecclesiastica karya Orderic Vitalis untuk iblis yang diusir dari sebuah gereja di Évreux. Para sarjana mengaitkannya dengan kata Yunani kóbalos ("bajingan" atau "roh usil") atau dengan kobold, roh rumah Jermanik. Kata Wales coblyn, sejenis knocker, berasal dari gobelin melalui kata Inggris goblin.
long_description.en: The word goblin entered English in the early 14th century from Old French gobelin, whose earliest known use, in 1195, is in Ambroise's chronicle L'Estoire de la guerre sainte; its Medieval Latin form gobelinus appears around 1140 in Orderic Vitalis's Historia ecclesiastica for a demon driven out of a church at Évreux. Scholars link it to Greek kóbalos ("rogue" or "mischievous sprite") or to the Germanic household spirit kobold. The Welsh coblyn, a kind of knocker, comes from gobelin through English goblin.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Inggris dan Skotlandia, goblin sering muncul sebagai brownie, roh rumah yang baik hati yang mengerjakan tugas rumah pada malam hari asal diberi bubur atau susu; boggart dari Yorkshire adalah varian yang lebih jahat. Menurut artikel id, goblin digambarkan sebagai makhluk kecil hijau bertelinga runcing yang serakah dan cinta emas; dalam versi fantasi lain mereka makhluk buas yang tinggal di gua-gua gelap atau di bawah tanah.
long_description.en: In English and Scottish folklore goblins often appear as brownies, kindly house spirits doing chores at night if given porridge or milk; the boggarts of Yorkshire are a more malevolent variant. According to the id article, goblins are pictured as small green beings with pointed ears who are greedy and love gold; in other fantasy versions they are savage creatures living in dark caves or underground.

short_description.id: Vamana (Wamana) adalah awatara kelima Dewa Wisnu dalam agama Hindu, brahmana kerdil yang merebut kembali tiga dunia dari raja daitya Mahabali dengan tiga langkah.
short_description.en: Vamana is the fifth avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, a dwarf brahmin who won back the three worlds from the daitya king Mahabali with three steps.

long_description.id: Vamana (Sanskerta वामन, "kerdil"), juga dikenal sebagai Trivikrama ("tiga langkah"), Urukrama, dan Upendra, adalah awatara dewa Hindu Wisnu (Vishnu). Ia awatara kelima Wisnu dan Dashavatara pertama pada Treta Yuga, sesudah Narasimha. Pertama disebut dalam Weda, Vamana paling sering dikaitkan dalam epos dan Purana Hindu dengan kisah merebut kembali tiga dunia (Trailokya) dari raja daitya Mahabali dengan tiga langkah, untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmos dan mendorong Mahabali ke dunia bawah. Ia yang termuda di antara para aditya, putra Aditi dan resi Kashyapa.
long_description.en: Vamana (Sanskrit वामन, "dwarf"), also called Trivikrama ("three steps"), Urukrama and Upendra, is an avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu. Coming after Narasimha, he is the fifth of Vishnu's avatars and the first Dashavatara of the Treta Yuga. Already named in the Vedas, Vamana is best known in the Hindu epics and Puranas to the tale of reclaiming the three worlds (Trailokya) from the daitya king Mahabali with three steps, restoring the cosmic order and pushing Mahabali into the netherworld. He is the youngest of the adityas, sons of Aditi and the sage Kashyapa.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel id, Wamana dilukiskan sebagai brahmana berraga anak kecil yang membawa kamandalu dan payung. Kisahnya dimuat dalam Bhagawatapurana, Brahmapurana, Padmapurana, Wamanapurana, dan Mahapurana lain: Raja Bali mengundang semua brahmana untuk diberi hadiah, dan meski dinasihati Sukracarya, ia mengabulkan permintaan brahmana kecil itu atas tanah seluas tiga langkah. Brahmana itu lalu membesar; langkah pertamanya menginjak swarga, langkah kedua bumi, dan untuk langkah ketiga Bali menyerahkan kepalanya. Terkesan oleh kedermawanannya, Wamana memberinya gelar Mahabali dan berjanji ia kelak menjadi Indra pada Manwantara berikutnya.
long_description.en: According to the id article, Wamana is pictured as a brahmin in a child's body carrying a kamandalu and an umbrella. His story is in the Bhagawatapurana, Brahmapurana, Padmapurana, Wamanapurana and other Mahapuranas: King Bali invited all brahmins to receive gifts, and despite Sukracarya's warning he granted the little brahmin's request for land three strides wide. The brahmin then grew; his first stride covered heaven (swarga), the second the earth, and for the third Bali offered his head. Impressed by his generosity, Wamana gave him the title Mahabali and promised he would become Indra in the next Manwantara.

long_description.id: Kisah Wamana dan Raja Bali diperingati setiap tahun dalam perayaan Onam di Kerala, India, tempat juga terdapat kuil khusus untuknya; kuil Wamana lain antara lain ada di Kanchipuram, dekat kuil Kamakshi.
long_description.en: The story of Wamana and King Bali is commemorated every year at the Onam festival in Kerala, India, where there is also a temple devoted to him; other Wamana temples include one in Kanchipuram near the Kamakshi temple.

role.id: Merebut tiga dunia dengan tiga langkah.

statement.en: Wamana's story in the Bhagawatapurana, Brahmapurana, Padmapurana, Wamanapurana and other Mahapuranas: he came to King Bali's (Raja Bali) palace when Bali invited brahmins for gifts, though Sukracarya had warned Bali.

statement.id: Brahmana kecil meminta tanah tiga langkah; Raja Bali mengabulkan, lalu brahmana itu membesar hingga melangkah di surga dan bumi sekaligus.
statement.en: The little brahmin asked for land of three strides; King Bali (Raja Bali) granted it, and the brahmin grew until he strode over heaven (surga) and earth (bumi) at once.

claims.quote: Pada langkah yang pertama, ia menginjak swarga. Pada langkah yang kedua, ia menginjak bumi. Pada langkah yang ketiga, karena tidak ada lahan untuknya berpijak, maka Bali menyerahkan kepalanya.

statement.en: His first step trod swarga, the second the earth (bumi), and for the third Bali offered his head (kepalanya).

claims.quote: Karena terkesan dengan kedermawanan Bali, Wamana memberinya gelar "Mahabali". Ia juga berjanji bahwa kelak Bali akan menjabat sebagai Indra (pemimpin para dewa) pada Manwantara berikutnya.

statement.id: Terkesan kedermawanan Bali, Wamana memberi gelar Mahabali dan menjanjikan jabatan Indra pada Manwantara berikutnya.

short_description.id: Rusalka adalah makhluk perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Slavia yang erat dengan air dan sering memusuhi manusia, biasanya arwah perempuan muda yang mati tenggelam.
short_description.en: The rusalka is a female being of Slavic folklore, closely tied to water and often hostile to people, usually the spirit of a young woman who drowned.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Slavia, rusalka adalah sosok perempuan yang sering berbuat jahat kepada manusia dan biasanya dikaitkan dengan air. Padanannya di Eropa lain antara lain Melusine dari Prancis dan Nixie dari dunia Jermanik. Di Rusia utara ia punya banyak sebutan seperti vodyanitsa, sedangkan di Ukraina ia disebut mavka.
long_description.en: In Slavic folklore the rusalka is a female figure, frequently harmful to people and usually associated with water. Her counterparts elsewhere in Europe include the French Melusine and the Germanic Nixie. In northern Russia she had many names, such as vodyanitsa, while in Ukraine she was called a mavka.

long_description.id: Menurut kebanyakan cerita, arwah perempuan muda yang mati di atau dekat sungai atau danau kembali menghantui perairan itu. Ia tidak selalu jahat dan dapat beristirahat dengan tenang bila kematiannya dibalas, tetapi tujuan utamanya memikat pemuda dengan rupa atau suaranya, lalu menjerat kaki mereka dengan rambut panjangnya dan menenggelamkan mereka. Dalam sebagian cerita, korban dibunuh dengan digelitik sampai mati atau dipaksa ikut tarian yang liar. Rambutnya selalu terurai dan bisa pirang, hitam, kehijauan, atau hijau sama sekali.
long_description.en: In most stories the soul of a young woman who died in or near a river or lake returns to haunt those waters. She is not always malevolent and may rest in peace once her death is avenged, but her chief aim is to lure young men with her looks or voice, bind their feet with her long hair and drag them under. In some tales victims were tickled to death or forced to join a frenzied dance. Her hair is always loose and may be fair, black, greenish or entirely green.

long_description.id: Gambaran rusalka berbeda menurut daerah. Di Ukraina ia lebih sering dikaitkan dengan air, di Belarus dengan hutan dan ladang; biasanya ia digambarkan sebagai gadis cantik tanpa busana, tetapi di beberapa tempat sebagai makhluk buruk rupa dan berbulu. Rusalka dipercaya paling berbahaya pada Pekan Rusalka di awal Juni, ketika mereka keluar dari air untuk berayun di dahan pohon birch dan willow pada malam hari, sehingga berenang saat itu dilarang keras.
long_description.en: Images of the rusalka varied by region. In Ukraine she was more often tied to water, in Belarus to forest and field; she was usually a beautiful naked maiden, but in some areas a hideous, hairy creature. Rusalki were thought most dangerous during Rusalka Week in early June, when they left the water to swing on birch and willow branches at night, so swimming then was strictly forbidden.

long_description.id: Namanya berasal dari rusalija, yang masuk ke bahasa Slavia lewat bahasa Yunani Bizantium dari kata Latin Rosālia, nama untuk Pentakosta dan hari-hari di sekitarnya. Menurut Vladimir Propp, bangsa Slavia pagan semula mengaitkan rusalka dengan kesuburan: mereka keluar dari air pada musim semi untuk membawa kelembapan ke ladang dan tidak dianggap jahat sebelum abad ke-19. Dalam versi abad ke-19, rusalka menjadi makhluk mati yang gelisah dan berbahaya.
long_description.en: Her name comes from rusalija, which reached the Slavic languages through Byzantine Greek from the Latin Rosālia, a name for Pentecost and the days around it. According to Vladimir Propp, pagan Slavs first linked rusalki with fertility: they rose from the water in spring to bring moisture to the fields and were not thought evil before the 19th century. In 19th-century versions the rusalka became a restless, dangerous dead being.

claims.quote: In Slavic folklore, the rusalka (plural: rusalki; Cyrillic: русалка, Russian pronunciation ... is a female entity, often malicious toward mankind and frequently associated with water. It has counterparts in other parts of Europe, such as the French Melusine and the Germanic Nixie.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Slavia, rusalka (русалка) adalah sosok perempuan yang sering memusuhi manusia dan sering dikaitkan dengan air; padanannya di Eropa lain antara lain Melusine dari Prancis dan Nixie dari dunia Jermanik.
statement.en: In Slavic folklore the rusalka (русалка) is a female entity, often malicious toward people and frequently associated with water; counterparts elsewhere in Europe include the French Melusine and the Germanic Nixie.

claims.quote: In northern Russia, the rusalka was also known by various names such as the vodyanitsa ... In Ukraine, the rusalka was called a mavka.

statement.id: Di Rusia utara rusalka juga dikenal dengan berbagai nama seperti vodyanitsa; di Ukraina ia disebut mavka.
statement.en: In northern Russia the rusalka was also known by names such as vodyanitsa; in Ukraine she was called a mavka.

claims.quote: The term "Rusalka" derives from "rusalija" ... which entered Slavic languages, via Byzantine Greek "rousália" ... from the Latin "Rosālia" as a name for Pentecost and the days adjacent to it.

statement.id: Istilah "rusalka" berasal dari "rusalija", yang masuk ke bahasa Slavia melalui bahasa Yunani Bizantium "rousália" dari kata Latin "Rosālia", nama untuk Pentakosta dan hari-hari di sekitarnya.
statement.en: The term "rusalka" derives from "rusalija", which entered Slavic via Byzantine Greek "rousália" from the Latin "Rosālia", a name for Pentecost and the adjacent days.

claims.quote: According to Vladimir Propp, the original "rusalka" was an appellation used by pagan Slavic peoples, who linked them with fertility and did not consider rusalki evil before the 19th century. They came out of the water in the spring to transfer life-giving moisture to the fields

statement.id: Menurut Vladimir Propp, bangsa Slavia pagan mengaitkan rusalka dengan kesuburan dan tidak menganggapnya jahat sebelum abad ke-19; rusalka keluar dari air pada musim semi untuk membawa kelembapan pemberi kehidupan ke ladang.
statement.en: According to Vladimir Propp, pagan Slavs linked rusalki with fertility and did not consider them evil before the 19th century; they came out of the water in spring to bring life-giving moisture to the fields.

claims.quote: In 19th-century versions, a rusalka is an unquiet, dangerous being who is no longer alive, associated with the unclean spirit.

statement.id: Dalam versi abad ke-19, rusalka adalah makhluk yang sudah mati, gelisah, dan berbahaya, yang dikaitkan dengan roh najis.
statement.en: In 19th-century versions the rusalka is a restless, dangerous being no longer alive, associated with the unclean spirit.

claims.quote: It is accounted by most stories that the soul of a young woman who had died in or near a river or a lake would come back to haunt that waterway. This undead rusalka is not invariably malevolent, and would be allowed to die in peace if her death is avenged.

statement.id: Menurut kebanyakan cerita, arwah perempuan muda yang mati di atau dekat sungai atau danau kembali menghantui perairan itu; rusalka mayat hidup ini tidak selalu jahat dan dapat mati dengan tenang bila kematiannya dibalas.
statement.en: Most stories say the soul of a young woman who died in or near a river or lake returns to haunt it; this undead rusalka is not always malevolent and may die in peace if her death is avenged.

claims.quote: Her main purpose is, however, to lure young men, seduced by either her looks or her voice, into the depths of said waterways where she would entangle their feet with her long hair and submerge them.

statement.id: Tujuan utamanya adalah memikat pemuda dengan rupa atau suaranya ke kedalaman perairan, lalu menjerat kaki mereka dengan rambut panjangnya dan menenggelamkan mereka.
statement.en: Her main purpose is to lure young men with her looks or voice into the depths, entangle their feet in her long hair and drown them.

claims.quote: They killed their victims by tickling them to death or forcing them to participate in a frenzied dance.

statement.id: Mereka membunuh korban dengan menggelitikinya sampai mati atau memaksanya ikut serta dalam tarian yang liar.
statement.en: They killed their victims by tickling them to death or forcing them into a frenzied dance.

claims.quote: In stories from Ukraine, they were often linked with water. In Belarus they were linked with the forest and field. They were usually pictured as beautiful naked maidens, but in some areas they were imagined as hideous and hairy.

statement.id: Dalam cerita dari Ukraina rusalka sering dikaitkan dengan air, di Belarus dengan hutan dan ladang; biasanya mereka digambarkan sebagai gadis cantik tanpa busana, tetapi di beberapa daerah sebagai makhluk buruk rupa dan berbulu.
statement.en: In Ukrainian stories rusalki were often linked with water, in Belarus with forest and field; usually pictured as beautiful naked maidens, in some areas they were hideous and hairy.

claims.quote: The rusalki were believed to be at their most dangerous during the 'Rusalka week' ... in early June. At this time, they were supposed to have left their watery depths in order to swing on branches of birch and willow trees by night.

statement.id: Rusalka dipercaya paling berbahaya pada Pekan Rusalka di awal Juni, ketika mereka keluar dari air untuk berayun di dahan pohon birch dan willow pada malam hari.
statement.en: Rusalki were believed most dangerous during Rusalka Week in early June, when they left the water to swing on birch and willow branches at night.

claims.quote: Swimming during this week was strictly forbidden, lest mermaids drag a swimmer down to the river bed.

statement.id: Selama pekan itu berenang dilarang keras, agar perenang tidak diseret ke dasar sungai.
statement.en: Swimming that week was strictly forbidden, lest a swimmer be dragged to the river bed.

claims.quote: the currently dominant presents her as something like a mermaid, though she is pictured as having legs rather than a fish tail ... In the past, her image was more complex and she more closely resembled a nature spirit, found not only near water but in fields, forests, and mountains, rather like the vila

statement.id: Menurut seorang ahli folklor, gambaran yang kini dominan menyerupai putri duyung tetapi berkaki, bukan berekor ikan; dulu gambarannya lebih rumit dan lebih mirip roh alam yang ditemukan di dekat air, ladang, hutan, dan gunung.
statement.en: According to a folklorist, the dominant image today is mermaid-like but with legs rather than a fish tail; formerly she was more complex, closer to a nature spirit found by water, in fields, forests and mountains.

claims.quote: 1901 – Rusalka, an opera by Antonín Dvořák.
claims.locator: List of notable works featuring rusalki

statement.id: Pada 1901 Antonín Dvořák menggubah opera Rusalka.
statement.en: In 1901 Antonín Dvořák composed the opera Rusalka.

claims.quote: Menurut sebagian besar tradisi, rusalka merupakan perempuan ikan, yang tinggal di dasar sungai. Rusalka berasal dari para perempuan yang meninggal di sungai.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian besar tradisi, rusalka adalah perempuan ikan yang tinggal di dasar sungai dan berasal dari perempuan yang meninggal di sungai.
statement.en: In most traditions the rusalka is a fish-woman living on the river bed, arising from women who died in the river.

claims.quote: Rusalka tidak bisa tinggal lama di atas permukaan, tetapi sisir mereka bisa mengeluarkan air untuk membasahi rambut mereka, jika rambutnya kering maka rusalka akan mati.

statement.id: Rusalka tidak bisa lama di atas permukaan air, tetapi sisirnya dapat mengeluarkan air untuk membasahi rambutnya; jika rambutnya kering, rusalka akan mati.
statement.en: The rusalka cannot stay long above water, but her comb can produce water to wet her hair; if her hair dries, she dies.

claims.quote: In most beliefs rusalki always have loose hair ... The hair of the rusalka can be fair, black, greenish or completely green.

statement.id: Dalam kebanyakan kepercayaan rambut rusalka selalu terurai, dan warnanya bisa pirang, hitam, kehijauan, atau hijau sepenuhnya.
statement.en: In most beliefs rusalki always have loose hair, which can be fair, black, greenish or completely green.

summary.en: One view: originally a fertility spirit, not considered evil before the 19th century.

summary.id: Versi abad ke-19: makhluk mati yang gelisah dan berbahaya.
summary.en: 19th-century versions: a restless, dangerous dead being.

short_description.id: Binatang Gévaudan adalah satu atau lebih binatang pemangsa manusia yang meneror Gévaudan, Prancis, pada 1764–1767, yang identitasnya masih diperdebatkan sampai kini.
short_description.en: The Beast of Gévaudan was one or more man-eating animals that terrorised Gévaudan, France, in 1764–1767, whose identity is still debated.

long_description.id: Binatang Gévaudan adalah nama untuk satu atau lebih pemangsa manusia yang meneror Gévaudan di Pegunungan Margeride, Prancis, sejak 30 Juni 1764; korban resmi pertamanya Jeanne Boulet, 14 tahun. Saksi menggambarkannya cokelat kemerahan bergaris gelap, sebesar anak sapi, berekor panjang berjumbai, dan bergerak seolah terbang; artikel bahasa Jepang menyebut ia sering menyasar kepala korban. Sebuah kajian tahun 1987 menghitung 210 serangan dan 113 korban tewas.
long_description.en: The Beast of Gévaudan is the name for one or more man-eaters that terrorised Gévaudan in the Margeride Mountains of France from 30 June 1764; its first official victim was 14-year-old Jeanne Boulet. Witnesses described it as russet with dark stripes, calf-sized, with a long tufted tail, moving as if flying; the Japanese article says it often went for the head. A 1987 study counted 210 attacks and 113 deaths.

long_description.id: Kerajaan Prancis mengerahkan bangsawan, tentara, dan pemburu kerajaan untuk memburunya, dan beberapa binatang dibunuh sebelum serangan berhenti, meski saksi menyebut ia berkali-kali terluka tanpa mati. Identitasnya, dubuk, serigala, anjing besar, atau anjing-serigala, masih diperdebatkan, dan sumber berbeda soal akhir masa serangan (1767 atau 1770).
long_description.en: The Kingdom of France sent nobles, soldiers and royal huntsmen after it, and several animals were killed before the attacks ceased, though witnesses said it was wounded many times without dying. Its identity, hyena, wolf, big dog or wolfdog, is still debated, and sources differ on when the attacks ended (1767 or 1770).

description.id: Bekas provinsi yang diteror binatang ini.
description.en: The former province the beast terrorised.

description.id: Jeanne Boulet tewas dekat Langogne pada 30 Juni.
description.en: Jeanne Boulet is killed near Langogne on 30 June.

claims.quote: The Beast of Gévaudan ... is the historic name associated with a man-eating cryptid or cryptids that terrorized the former province of Gévaudan ... in the Margeride Mountains of south-central France between 30 June 1764 and 19 June 1767.

statement.id: Binatang Gévaudan (La Bête du Gévaudan) adalah nama historis untuk satu atau lebih kriptid pemangsa manusia yang meneror bekas provinsi Gévaudan di Pegunungan Margeride, Prancis selatan-tengah, antara 30 Juni 1764 dan 19 Juni 1767.
statement.en: The Beast of Gévaudan (La Bête du Gévaudan) is the historic name for one or more man-eating cryptids that terrorised the former province of Gévaudan in the Margeride Mountains of south-central France between 30 June 1764 and 19 June 1767.

claims.quote: were said to have been committed by one or more beasts of a tawny/russet colour with dark streaks/stripes and a dark stripe down its back, a tail "longer than a wolf's" ending in a tuft according to contemporary eyewitnesses.

statement.id: Menurut saksi mata masa itu, serangan dilakukan satu atau lebih binatang berwarna cokelat kemerahan dengan belang gelap dan garis gelap di punggung, berekor lebih panjang daripada serigala dengan jumbai di ujungnya.
statement.en: Contemporary witnesses said the attacks were by one or more tawny-russet beasts with dark stripes and a dark stripe down the back, with a tail 'longer than a wolf's' ending in a tuft.

claims.quote: It was said to attack with formidable teeth and claws, and appeared to be the size of a calf or cow and seemed to fly or bound across fields towards its victims.

statement.id: Ia menyerang dengan gigi dan cakar yang mengerikan, tampak sebesar anak sapi atau sapi, dan seolah terbang atau melompat melintasi ladang ke arah korbannya.
statement.en: It attacked with fearsome teeth and claws, looked the size of a calf or cow, and seemed to fly or bound across fields at its victims.

claims.quote: These descriptions from the period could identify the beast as a striped hyena, a large wolf, a large dog, or a wolfdog, though its identity is still the subject of debate and remains unsolved to this day.

statement.id: Gambaran itu dapat cocok dengan dubuk belang, serigala besar, anjing besar, atau anjing-serigala, tetapi identitasnya masih diperdebatkan sampai kini.
statement.en: These descriptions could fit a striped hyena, a large wolf, a large dog or a wolfdog, but its identity is still debated and unsolved.

claims.quote: The Kingdom of France used a considerable amount of wealth and manpower to hunt the animals responsible, including the resources of several nobles, soldiers, royal huntsmen, and civilians.

statement.id: Kerajaan Prancis mengerahkan banyak dana dan tenaga untuk memburunya, termasuk bangsawan, tentara, pemburu kerajaan, dan warga.
statement.en: The Kingdom of France spent great wealth and manpower hunting the animals, including nobles, soldiers, royal huntsmen and civilians.

claims.quote: A 1987 study estimated there had been 210 attacks, resulting in 113 deaths and 49 injuries; 98 of the victims killed were partly eaten.

statement.id: Sebuah kajian tahun 1987 memperkirakan 210 serangan dengan 113 korban tewas dan 49 terluka; 98 korban tewas sebagian dimakan.
statement.en: A 1987 study estimated 210 attacks causing 113 deaths and 49 injuries; 98 of those killed were partly eaten.

claims.quote: Shortly afterwards, on 30 June, the beast's first official victim was recorded: 14-year-old Jeanne Boulet was killed near the village of Les Hubacs near Langogne.

statement.id: Korban resmi pertamanya tercatat pada 30 Juni 1764: Jeanne Boulet, 14 tahun, yang tewas dekat desa Les Hubacs di dekat Langogne.
statement.en: Its first official victim was recorded on 30 June 1764: 14-year-old Jeanne Boulet, killed near the village of Les Hubacs near Langogne.

claims.quote: Several animals identified as the beast were reportedly killed before the attacks finally stopped.

statement.id: Beberapa binatang yang dianggap sebagai Binatang Gévaudan dilaporkan dibunuh sebelum serangan akhirnya berhenti.
statement.en: Several animals identified as the beast were reportedly killed before the attacks finally stopped.

claims.quote: adalah nama historis yang merujuk kepada hewan mirip serigala pemangsa manusia yang meneror bekas provinsi Gévaudan (kini département Lozère bagian dari wilayah Haute-Loire), di Pegunungan Margeride di Prancis Selatan antara tahun 1764 dan 1770.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Indonesia menyebut serangan hewan mirip serigala pemangsa manusia ini berlangsung antara 1764 dan 1770.
statement.en: The Indonesian article dates the man-eating wolf-like beast's attacks between 1764 and 1770.

claims.quote: Saksi juga menyatakan bahwa makhluk tersebut telah dilukai berkali-kali tetapi tidak kunjung mati.

statement.id: Saksi juga menyatakan makhluk itu sudah dilukai berkali-kali, termasuk ditembak dari jarak dekat, tetapi tidak juga mati.
statement.en: Witnesses also said the creature had been wounded many times, even shot at close range, yet did not die.

claims.quote: この生き物の伝えられた殺害の仕方は捕食動物としては異常で、しばしば獲物の頭部を標的にし、普通なら捕食動物が狙う脚や喉を全く無視していた。

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jepang, cara membunuhnya tidak lazim bagi pemangsa: ia sering menyasar kepala korban dan mengabaikan kaki dan leher yang biasa disasar pemangsa.
statement.en: According to the Japanese article its killing method was unusual for a predator: it often went for the victim's head, ignoring the legs and throat predators usually target.

summary.en: A striped hyena, large wolf, big dog or wolfdog; unsolved.

short_description.id: Incubus adalah iblis lelaki dalam cerita rakyat yang muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayunya, menguras kesehatannya, dan konon menjadi ayah Merlin.
short_description.en: The incubus is a male demon of folklore who appears in women's dreams to seduce them, drains their health and is said to have fathered Merlin.

long_description.id: Incubus, dari bahasa Latin incubō, "yang menindih orang tidur", adalah iblis lelaki yang muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayunya; hubungan berulang dengannya dapat melahirkan kambion tetapi merusak kesehatan bahkan membunuh. Ia konon dapat menyusup sebagai kelelawar, dan penyihir Merlin dikatakan anaknya. Kepercayaan ini didorong mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur; kini ia sering digambarkan sebagai lelaki tampan.
long_description.en: The incubus, from Latin incubō, 'what lies on one while asleep', is a male demon who appears in women's dreams to seduce them; repeated unions can produce a cambion but ruin health or kill. He is said to slip in as a bat, and the magician Merlin was called his son. The belief was driven by wet dreams and sleep paralysis; today he is often drawn as a handsome man.

long_description.id: Jejaknya sudah ada di Mesopotamia: Daftar Raja Sumeria sekitar 2400 SM menyebut Lilu, perayu perempuan dalam tidur, sebagai ayah Gilgamesh, dan Idlu lili mendatangi perempuan pada malam hari. Agustinus mencatat bahwa roh hutan Silvanus dan Faunus disebut incubi.
long_description.en: Its roots reach Mesopotamia: the Sumerian King List of c. 2400 BC names Lilu, seducer of sleeping women, as Gilgamesh's father, and Idlu lili visits women by night. Augustine records that the forest spirits Silvanus and Faunus were called incubi.

literal_meaning.en: what lies on one while asleep

note.en: His female counterpart.
A similar Mesopotamian demon.

claims.quote: An incubus ... incubi) is a male demon who is described in various folklore as appearing in the dreams of female humans in order to seduce them.

statement.id: Incubus (jamak: incubi) adalah iblis lelaki yang dalam berbagai cerita rakyat muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayu mereka.
statement.en: An incubus (plural incubi) is a male demon said in various folklore to appear in women's dreams to seduce them.

claims.quote: Pembentukan dan kelestarian hubungan semacam itu memungkinkan lahirnya anak hibrida yang dikenal sebagai kambion

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Indonesia, hubungan yang berulang dengan incubus dapat melahirkan anak hibrida yang disebut kambion.
statement.en: According to the Indonesian article, a lasting relationship with an incubus can produce a hybrid child called a cambion.

claims.quote: In modern representations, an incubus is often depicted as a handsome man seducer or charming, rather than as demonic or frightening, to attract people instead of repulsing them. The female counterpart of the incubus is the succubus.

statement.id: Dalam gambaran modern, incubus sering tampil sebagai lelaki tampan penggoda, bukan iblis menakutkan; padanan perempuannya adalah succubus.
statement.en: In modern depictions the incubus is often a handsome seducer rather than a frightening demon; his female counterpart is the succubus.

claims.quote: Historically, folkloric belief in incubi was motivated by distressing nighttime phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

statement.id: Kepercayaan pada incubi didorong gejala malam yang meresahkan, terutama mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur.
statement.en: Belief in incubi was driven by distressing night phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

claims.quote: Legendary magician Merlin was said to have been fathered by an incubus. Walter Stephens writes in his book Demon Lovers that some traditions hold that repeated sexual activity with an incubus or succubus may result in the deterioration of health, an impaired mental state, or even death.

statement.id: Penyihir legendaris Merlin konon anak incubus, dan Walter Stephens dalam Demon Lovers menulis bahwa menurut sebagian tradisi hubungan berulang dengan incubus atau succubus dapat merusak kesehatan, jiwa, bahkan menyebabkan kematian.
statement.en: The legendary magician Merlin was said to be an incubus's son, and Walter Stephens writes in Demon Lovers that some traditions hold repeated relations with an incubus or succubus may ruin health and mind or even kill.

claims.quote: The Late Latin word incubus ("a nightmare induced by a demon") is derived from Latin incubō ("nightmare, what lies down on one whilst one sleeps") and further from incubāre ("to lie upon, to hatch").

statement.id: Kata Latin Akhir incubus, "mimpi buruk yang ditimbulkan iblis", berasal dari incubō, "yang menindih orang tidur", dan incubāre, "berbaring di atas".
statement.en: The Late Latin incubus, 'a demon-induced nightmare', comes from incubō, 'what lies on one while asleep', and incubāre, 'to lie upon'.

claims.quote: One of the earliest evident mentions of a demon sharing qualities with an incubus comes from Mesopotamia on the Sumerian King List, circa 2400 BC, where the hero Gilgamesh's father is listed as Lilu. Lilu is described as "disturbing" and "seducing" women in their sleep

statement.id: Salah satu sebutan tertua iblis mirip incubus ada dalam Daftar Raja Sumeria dari Mesopotamia sekitar 2400 SM, yang mencantumkan Lilu, iblis yang mengganggu dan merayu perempuan dalam tidur, sebagai ayah pahlawan Gilgamesh.
statement.en: One of the earliest mentions of an incubus-like demon is on the Sumerian King List from Mesopotamia, c. 2400 BC, naming Lilu, who 'disturbs' and 'seduces' sleeping women, as the father of the hero Gilgamesh.

claims.quote: Two other corresponding demons also appear in Mesopotamian accounts: Ardat lili, who visits men by night, and Idlu lili, a male counterpart to Ardat lili who visits women by night and begets from them.

statement.id: Catatan Mesopotamia juga menyebut Ardat lili yang mendatangi lelaki pada malam hari dan Idlu lili, padanan lelakinya, yang mendatangi perempuan dan membuat mereka hamil.
statement.en: Mesopotamian accounts also name Ardat lili, who visits men by night, and Idlu lili, her male counterpart, who visits women by night and begets on them.

claims.quote: 古くはアウグスティヌス『神の国』第15巻23章に、森の精霊シルウァーヌスやファウヌスはインキュバスと呼ばれ、しばしば女性を襲って欲望を満たす、という当時の俗信についての記述がある。

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jepang, Agustinus dalam De Civitate Dei buku 15 bab 23 mencatat kepercayaan masa itu bahwa roh hutan Silvanus dan Faunus disebut incubi dan sering menyerang perempuan.
statement.en: According to the Japanese article, Augustine in The City of God (book 15, chapter 23) records the belief of his time that the forest spirits Silvanus and Faunus were called incubi and often assailed women.

claims.quote: どちらも、自分と性交したくてたまらなくさせるために、襲われる人の理想の異性像で、服を着ず下半身は裸で現れる。そのため、その誘惑を拒否することは非常に困難だった。人の形態をとるだけでなく、標的となった人間の寝室には蝙蝠に化けて侵入するともされている。

statement.id: Incubus dan succubus muncul sebagai sosok lawan jenis idaman korbannya sehingga godaannya sangat sulit ditolak, dan selain berwujud manusia mereka konon menyusup ke kamar korban dalam wujud kelelawar.
statement.en: Incubi and succubi appear as their victim's ideal partner, so their temptation is very hard to refuse, and besides human form they are said to slip into the victim's bedroom as bats.

long_description.en: Her cult is known from at least the Early Dynastic Period. She is regarded as wife of Khnum, who shapes children’s bodies on a potter’s wheel. In the Osiris myth she breathes life into Horus at birth. The accompanying source depicts her as a frog or frog-headed woman.

claims.quote: Heqet (Egyptian ḥqt, also ḥqtyt "Heqtit"), sometimes spelled Heket, is an Egyptian goddess of fertility, identified with Hathor, represented in the form of a frog.

statement.id: Heqet adalah dewi kesuburan Mesir yang digambarkan sebagai katak.
statement.en: Heqet is an Egyptian fertility goddess depicted as a frog.

claims.quote:
To the Egyptians, the frog was an ancient symbol of fertility, related to the annual flooding of the Nile. 
Heqet was originally the female counterpart of Khnum, or the wife of Khnum, and eventually she also became the mother of Heru-ur.
It has been proposed that her name is the origin of the name of Hecate, the Greek goddess of witchcraft.

statement.id: Katak berkaitan dengan banjir tahunan Nil dan kesuburan.
statement.en: The frog is linked with the annual Nile flood and fertility.

claims.quote: The beginning of her cult dates to the Early Dynastic Period at least. Her name was part of the names of some high-born Second Dynasty individuals buried at Helwan, such as prince Nisuheqet, and was mentioned on a stela of Wepemnofret and in the Pyramid Texts. Early frog statuettes are often thought to be depictions of her.

statement.id: Kultusnya diketahui setidaknya sejak masa Dinasti Awal.
statement.en: Her cult is known from at least the Early Dynastic Period.

claims.quote: Heqet was considered the wife of Khnum, who formed the bodies of new children on his potter's wheel.

statement.id: Ia dianggap sebagai istri Khnum yang membentuk tubuh anak dengan roda tembikar.
statement.en: She is regarded as wife of Khnum, who shapes children’s bodies on a potter’s wheel.

claims.quote: In the Osiris myth, it was Heqet who breathed life into the new body of Horus at birth, as she was a goddess of the last moments of birth. As the birth of Horus became more intimately associated with the resurrection of Osiris, so Heqet's role became one more closely associated with resurrection.

short_description.en: Pangu is a primordial creation figure in Chinese mythology who separates heaven from earth.

long_description.id: Pangu (盤古, juga ditulis Pan Gu, Peng Gu, atau P'an Ku) adalah makhluk purba dan tokoh penciptaan dalam mitologi Tiongkok dan Taoisme. Menurut legenda, Pangu memisahkan langit dan bumi, dan tubuhnya kemudian menjadi bentang alam seperti gunung dan aliran air. Werner menyebutnya tokoh paling menonjol dalam kosmogoni Tiongkok, yang memahat alam semesta dari Kekacauan. Penulis paling awal yang diketahui mencatat mitos ini diyakini adalah Xu Zheng pada periode Tiga Kerajaan.
long_description.en: Pangu (盤古; also Pan Gu, Peng Gu or P'an Ku) is an ancient being at the origin of Chinese creation stories, found in Chinese mythology and in Taoism. Legend holds that he pulled heaven and earth apart and that his body then turned into landforms such as mountains and rivers. Werner ranks him as the foremost figure of Chinese cosmogony, the one who carved the universe out of Chaos. The earliest writer known to have set the myth down is thought to be Xu Zheng, in the Three Kingdoms period.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah telur kosmik, alam semesta mula-mula tanpa bentuk dan menyatu menjadi telur selama sekitar 18.000 tahun; yin dan yang di dalamnya menjadi seimbang, lalu Pangu muncul. Menurut Werner, 'P'an' berarti 'cangkang telur'. Sebagian versi menyebut Pangu dibantu Empat Makhluk Bertuah. Menurut satu sumber ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai raksasa berbulu bertanduk, sedangkan Werner menggambarkannya sebagai pria kerdil bertanduk dua yang memegang palu dan pahat.
long_description.en: In the cosmic-egg story the universe begins as a featureless void that gathers into an egg over roughly 18,000 years; the yin and yang inside balance out and Pangu comes forth. Werner explains 'P'an' as 'the shell of an egg'. Some tellings have the Four Auspicious Beasts help him. One source says he is usually shown as a hairy, horned giant, while Werner pictures a dwarfish man with two horns holding a hammer and chisel.

long_description.id: Menurut Werner, pekerjaan Pangu memakan delapan belas ribu tahun, dan ia bertambah tinggi setiap hari sampai wafat. Setelah ia wafat, napasnya menjadi angin dan awan, suaranya guntur, dan matanya matahari dan bulan; dalam catatan Werner kepalanya menjadi gunung dan darahnya sungai. Werner menyatakan kisah ini berasal dari Tao dan bahwa versi umat Buddha adalah adaptasi belakangan, sedangkan legenda lain menyebut Pangu berkepala naga dan bertubuh ular.
long_description.en: By Werner's account Pangu's labour lasted eighteen thousand years, and he kept growing taller until he died. After his death his breath turned into wind and cloud, his voice into thunder, and his eyes into the sun and moon; in Werner's version his head became the mountains and his blood the rivers. Werner says the story is of Taoist origin and that the Buddhists' version is a later adaptation, while other legends give him a dragon's head and a serpent's body.

literal_meaning.id: 'P'an' berarti 'cangkang telur' dan 'Ku' berarti 'mengamankan' atau 'padat' (menurut Werner)
literal_meaning.en: 'P'an' means 'the shell of an egg' and 'Ku' 'to secure' or 'solid' (according to Werner)

description.id: Werner menyebut umat Buddha memberi kisah yang agak berbeda tentang P'an Ku, yang merupakan adaptasi belakangan dari mitos Tao.
description.en: Werner says the Buddhists gave a somewhat different account of P'an Ku, a late adaptation of the Taoist myth.

description.id: Dalam legenda lain, P'an Ku berkepala naga dan bertubuh ular.
description.en: In other legends P'an Ku has the head of a dragon and the body of a serpent.
